alt: Seats by bloc: PH 62, PN 62, BN 60, GPS 23, GRS 6, Others 9. 112 needed for a majority.
Seats and vote share: PH 62 seats on about 31% of the vote; PN 62 on about 30%; BN 60 on about 28%.
Change since GE15: PH 82 to 62, down 20; PN 74 to 62, down 12; BN 30 to 60, up 30; Others 7 to 9; GPS and GRS unchanged.
Build a government: PH 62 plus GPS 23, GRS 6 and Others 9 reaches 100. PN would reach 100 and BN 98. 112 needed.
Highlighted: PH 62 and BN 60, 122 seats together.
Highlighted: BN 60 seats, with PH 62 and PN 62 on either side.
Highlighted: PAS 41 and UMNO 53, 94 seats together.
Highlighted: Bersatu 20 seats. BN 60 and PAS 41 make 101.
Highlighted: GPS 23 and GRS 6, 29 seats, beside BN 60.

Three ways to 112, each with GPS and GRS. Option 1, PH + BN + Borneo: 151 seats, 39 above 112. Option 2, BN + PN + Borneo: 151 seats, 39 above 112. Option 3, PAS + UMNO + Borneo: 123 seats, 11 above 112.
